cells.gaps: No successor to the National Broadband Plan 2020-2025 has been found as adopted; the regulator said in April 2026 that one was being drawn up.
cells.note: The 2020-2025 plan expired in December 2025 and the regulator said in April 2026 it was preparing a successor, so stage 2 on both counts. Not stage 3: no successor is adopted.
